meta.name: aed:anchor-headings
meta.description: Master switch. Set content to 'on'/'true'/'1' to inject permalink anchors next to headings. Per-page opt-out: data-aed-anchor-headings='off' on <html>.

data-scope.description: CSS selector for the container holding processable headings.

data-levels.description: Comma-separated heading levels to process (e.g. '2,3,4' = h2/h3/h4).
